# E04 source audit 02 — ClickHouse already implements row-ID postings, token ordering and exact Map lookup

Date: 2026-11-03. **SOURCE-VERIFIED, NO NEW NATIVE BENCHMARK OR SPEEDUP CLAIM.** ClickHouse pinned TimeSeries v11 source `52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde`; VM pinned `v1.134.0`.

This corrects a possible wrong conclusion from the first E04 audit: **ClickHouse does not lack posting lists or all index-level cardinality estimates.** It has a sophisticated text inverted index with exact Map-pair token support, row-ID posting lists and query-level cost estimates. The essential gap to investigate is how to combine **time-local active-series selection**, the existing TAGS postings, the TimeRanges metadata JOIN and SAMPLES marks into one sensible native query plan. The findings below do not imply that CH and VM have equivalent cache/index semantics.

## 1. Source-backed mechanism matrix

| Mechanism | Already in CH | Comparison with VM |
|---|---|---|
| Inverted posting lists | [`MergeTreeIndexText.cpp` row-ID list read](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/blob/52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde/src/Storages/MergeTree/MergeTreeIndexText.cpp#L310-L379) uses per-segment row IDs, bitmap/array representations, and compressed postings codecs. [`TextIndexAnalyzer.cpp`](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/blob/52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde/src/Storages/MergeTree/TextIndexAnalyzer.cpp#L141-L158) combines postings by intersection/union. | VM [per-date/global tag → MetricID](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/blob/v1.134.0/lib/storage/index_db.go#L33-L72) postings are **stable series IDs**, not physical row IDs. Layout and update semantics differ. |
| Default TimeSeries label index | [`StorageTimeSeries.cpp`](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/blob/52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde/src/Storages/StorageTimeSeries.cpp#L1238-L1253): `TAGS INDEX tags_idx tags TYPE text(tokenizer='keyValuePairs') GRANULARITY 100000000`. TAGS sorted by `(metric_name,id)`; not by day. | VM also has composite metric-name+label postings, but they are additionally scoped by day. |
| Exact `tags['key']='value'` | [`StorageTimeSeriesSelector::matcherToAST`](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/blob/52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde/src/Storages/StorageTimeSeriesSelector.cpp#L355-L407) emits `equals(arrayElement(tags,key),value)` unless the label is promoted to a column. [Text index matching](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/blob/52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde/src/Storages/MergeTree/MergeTreeIndexConditionText.cpp#L2089-L2123) recognizes the `arrayElement` pattern, encodes the key-value pair and can use an exact token lookup. | CH exact pair lookup **already exists**; adding a second generic label index is not a source-justified first improvement. |
| Regex/negative/missing | [`matcherToAST`](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/blob/52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde/src/Storages/StorageTimeSeriesSelector.cpp#L367-L410) reduces a regex of literal alternatives to equality/`IN`, but arbitrary regex uses `match`; empty string can match missing Map label. [Key-value text index](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/blob/52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde/src/Storages/MergeTree/MergeTreeIndexConditionText.cpp#L2089-L2184) refuses index-only `tags['key']=''`, to avoid false negatives. | VM has separate negative/empty-filter logic and direct candidate-label checks. Maintain exact PromQL absence semantics and R08 oracle. |
| Cardinality-aware ordering | [`TokensCardinalitiesCache::sortTokens`](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/blob/52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde/src/Storages/MergeTree/TextIndexCache.cpp#L13-L51) orders tokens by previously checked hit ratio; [index-reader calls sortTokens](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/blob/52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde/src/Storages/MergeTree/MergeTreeIndexText.cpp#L700-L736). [`estimateQueryCardinality`](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/blob/52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde/src/Storages/MergeTree/TextIndexAnalyzer.cpp#L429-L507) estimates union/intersection using token cardinalities and an independence approximation. | VM [stores loop-count feedback per date and matcher](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/blob/v1.134.0/lib/storage/index_db.go#L2516-L2570), can switch remaining filters to direct check of the current MetricID set. CH token sorting is inside text-index analysis, **not equivalent to VM date-scoped planner feedback**. |
| Early skip and safe fallback | [`queryMayBeTrueInRange`](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/blob/52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde/src/Storages/MergeTree/MergeTreeIndexConditionText.cpp#L480-L515) can test Roaring posting bitmap intersections with row ranges without allocating an additional set; [`analyzeCardinalitiesAndBypassHints`](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/blob/52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde/src/Storages/MergeTree/TextIndexAnalyzer.cpp#L507-L536) estimates when hints should be used. | Both systems have selectivity logic, but it works on different physical entities and at different stages. |
| Posting cache | [`MergeTreeIndexConditionText`](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/blob/52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde/src/Storages/MergeTree/MergeTreeIndexConditionText.cpp#L208-L246) uses optional global token/header/postings caches or query-local LRU (≤200 MiB and ≤10% query memory). | VM [TagFilters→MetricIDs](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/blob/v1.134.0/lib/storage/index_db.go#L320-L350) caches the **complete matching ID set for matcher group and rounded date range**. The keys and invalidation mechanisms are different. |
| Date scope | No date dimension in default CH `TAGS` index or `TAGS ORDER BY` ([TimeSeries DDL](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/blob/52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde/src/Storages/StorageTimeSeries.cpp#L1277-L1338)); native [TimeRanges merge JOIN](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/blob/52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde/src/Storages/StorageTimeSeriesSelector.cpp#L498-L587) adds time selection later. SAMPLES monthly partitions and day option are R15 work. | VM [day/global access switch](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/blob/v1.134.0/lib/storage/storage.go#L1623-L1651) combines label and date when generating candidate IDs. [Measured R26](R26_VM_PERDAY_GLOBAL_RESULTS_20261103.md) confirms full native VM improvements in selective time scope. |

## 2. Why the ID domain matters

CH TAGS posting list = **physical row positions within an indexed data part**. A matching token selects rows from that part; it does not directly identify which `(id,bucket)` SAMPLES marks contain data for the query's time range. After the TAGS match, CH's native selector still needs the TimeRanges path (if enabled), the ID set and SAMPLES/aggregate work.

VM posting list = **series MetricIDs scoped to time when using day index**. It can intersect label predicates before searching storage blocks; the TSID-sorted part-search then intersects the query's TSIDs with per-block timestamp ranges ([part_search.go](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/blob/v1.134.0/lib/storage/part_search.go#L149-L305)).

This difference is a *plan and data-locality issue*, not an argument that CH lacks row-level posting lists. Per-day VM postings impose write costs; CH's global TAGS text index may be cheaper to update for long-lived series.

## 3. A cheap distinct E03 integration question

Do not build a second external inverted index just to test whether a source-preserving index benefits native queries. Determine what the nested `timeSeriesSelector` can report to the outer PromQL planner:

- Actual estimated match cardinality from TAGS text index per part, label predicate, absent/default handling, and available `tags_to_columns` statistics.
- Cost of the sorted-ID TimeRanges JOIN versus a bounded alternatives table; note `join_algorithm=full_sorting_merge` is forced in [`applySettingsForSelectIDsQuery`](https://github.com/moleus/ClickHouse/blob/52529f0c711566d696917678bf15e7068772fdde/src/Storages/StorageTimeSeriesSelector.cpp#L1167-L1174).
- A time/ID filtering choice: default global TAGS posting+TimeRanges vs R07-owned day-covering metadata, when the cost model predicts a win. No duplicate R07 sidecar launch.
- Whether native generic `avg by(stage)(avg_over_time(...))` pays tag materialization and grid aggregation costs after the metadata candidate set, even with exact posting hits; R07 previously measured ~2× full-query gain with unchanged sample marks.

The first actionable **measurement** is to collect `EXPLAIN indexes=1` for the exact TAGS nested query, text-index ProfileEvents and `read_rows/read_bytes` on existing R07/R15 fixtures. Separate **TAGS posting selection**, **TimeRanges JOIN**, and **SAMPLES mark read**; do not attribute all read_rows to metadata scan or all cpu to postings.

## 4. Limits

- Source code contains exact index reader and cardinality logic, but this report does **not** prove those mechanisms are selected for every native PromQL query. EXPLAIN and native processor evidence required.
- `TokensCardinalitiesCache` source is a per-query/postings-reader facility; **do not** call it a global learned query optimizer.
- Presence of `text_index_hint_max_selectivity` and alternate apply modes does not prove a native performance benefit at default settings.
- Correlated labels break naive independent selectivity approximations; E03 already owns such probes.
- R26 VM performance effects are VM-only and not directly transferable to CH without comparable physical index read/write and query-planner tests.

**Decision:** `SOURCE_PARITY_AUDIT_ACCEPT`, no source patch, no performance claim. Handoff to active E03 R06 owner by this shared file; E04 continues independent high-churn VM path R27.
